camel_example: aliyun cloudfw AddDnsFirewallPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Destination db_group --Description '放行指定域名' --IpVersion 4 --Priority 1 --SourceType net --AclAction log --DestinationType domain --Source '192.168.0.223/32' --Release true
description_en: Adds a DNS firewall access control list (ACL)
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw add-dns-firewall-policy --acl-action log --description '放行指定域名' --destination db_group --destination-type domain --source 192.168.0.223/32 --source-type net --priority 1 --release true --ip-version 4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDnsFirewallPolicy

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：-zh：中文-en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The action that Cloud Firewall performs on the traffic in the access control policy. Valid values:
accept: Allow.
drop: Deny.
log: Monitor
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中流量通过云防火墙的方式。取值：
accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en: The description of the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the access control policy.

If DestinationType is set to net, Destination is a destination CIDR block. Example: 1.2.3.4/24.
If DestinationType is set to group, Destination is a destination address book name. Example: db_group.
If DestinationType is set to domain, Destination is a destination domain name. Example: *.aliyuncs.com.
If DestinationType is set to location, Destination is a destination area (see the area positional encoding below). Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.help_zh:
安全访问控制策略中的目的地址。

当DestinationType为net时，Destination为目的CIDR。例如：1.2.3.4/24
当DestinationType为group时，Destination为目的地址簿名称。例如：db_group
当DestinationType为domain时，Destination为目的域名。例如：*.aliyuncs.com
当DestinationType为location时，Destination为目的区域（具体区域位置编码见后文）。例如： ["BJ11", "ZB"]
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en: The type of the destination address in the DNS firewall access control policy. Only group (destination address book) and domain (destination domain name) are supported. net and CIDR addresses are not applicable to this operation
parameters.help_zh: DNS 防火墙访问控制策略的目的地址类型。仅支持 group（目的地址簿）和 domain（目的域名）；net 与 CIDR 地址不适用于本接口
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
The traffic direction of the DNS firewall access control policy.

This parameter is not validated on the backend. When you create or modify a DNS firewall policy, the direction is always stored as out (outbound). Passing in does not cause an error or take effect. The DNS firewall supports only outbound policies
parameters.help_zh:
DNS 防火墙访问控制策略的流量方向。

本参数不参与后端校验：创建和修改 DNS 防火墙策略时，方向恒按 out（内对外）落库，传入 in 既不会报错也不会生效。DNS 防火墙仅支持出方向策略
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the access control policy. Valid values:

If SourceType is set to `net`, Source is a source CIDR block. Example: 10.2.XX.XX/24.

If SourceType is set to `group`, Source is a source address book name. Example: db_group
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址。取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，Source为源CIDR地址，例如：10.2.XX.XX/24

当SourceType为`group`时，Source为源地址簿名称，例如：db_group
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: source CIDR block

group: source address book
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址类型。取值：

net：源网段（CIDR）

group：源地址簿
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The policy priority of the DNS firewall policy. Valid values: 1 to 20000. A smaller value indicates a higher policy priority
parameters.help_zh: 新建 DNS 防火墙策略的优先级。取值范围为 1～20000，数值越小，策略优先级越高
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The enabled status of the access control policy. The policy is enabled by default after creation. Valid values:

true: Enable the access control policy.
false: Disable the access control policy
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略
false：不启用访问控制策略
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en:
The IP address version. Valid values:

4: IPv4

6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
支持的IP地址版本。

取值：

4：表示IPv4地址

6：表示IPv6地址
parameters.name: ip_version

AclUuid.description_en: The unique ID of the access control policy
AclUuid.description_zh: 安全访问控制策略的唯一标识ID
